name: pie
install:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
mise trust -y
mise install
mise exec -- pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

terminals.name: pie server
terminals.description: API + WS on :4180 (PIE_PORT). Health: curl http://127.0.0.1:4180/api/health. Drive the Vite origin on :4190, not this port — 4180 serves the last built bundle or 503s.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && mise exec -- pnpm --dir packages/pie dev

terminals.name: vite app
terminals.description: Vite on :4190, proxies /api and /ws/rpc to the pie server. Open http://localhost:4190/
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && mise exec -- pnpm --dir apps/app dev
